subtitle: What clients and partners accept when they first sign in to the cabinet
noneYet: Nothing is published yet — the cabinet is open without acceptance. Once you publish, every contact accepts the text on sign-in.
loadErrorText: Check the connection and try again.

editions.title: Editions
editions.listLabel: Editions of the offer and the policy

publish.title: Publish edition “{{label}}”?
publish.text: All cabinet contacts will accept the new edition the next time they sign in. Those in the cabinet now will see the acceptance screen on their next action.
publish.replaces: It replaces edition “{{label}}”: its acceptances stay in the log.
publish.immutable: A published text cannot be changed — a new edition is created for any correction.

discard.title: Delete draft “{{label}}”?
discard.text: The draft text will be lost. The edition in force does not change.

created: Draft “{{label}}” created — a copy of the edition in force.

reader.title: {{kind}} · edition of {{date}}
reader.note: This is what the contact sees: company details are already filled in.

editor.title: Draft: {{kind}}
editor.label: Edition name
editor.labelHelp: For example, a date: 2026-12-01. Shown in the acceptance log.
editor.bodyHelp: Paragraphs go on new lines; list items start with “— ”. Placeholders are filled with company details: {{list}}.
editor.threeLanguages: Each section needs a title and text in all three languages — switch the language above. The list of sections is shared by the languages.
editor.consequence: Clients see the edition in force until the draft is published. Publish from the list of editions.
editor.discardText: Changes to the text will be lost.

errors.default: The action failed. Please try again.
errors.legal_draft_exists: This document already has a draft: open it and edit.
errors.legal_edition_published: The edition is already published and does not change. Create a new one.
errors.legal_label_taken: This name is already used. Choose another.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check that every section has a title and text in all three languages.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to change the offer and the policy.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The edition no longer exists. Refresh the page.

log.title: Who accepted
log.label: Acceptance filter
log.capped: Showing the latest {{shown}} — narrow the search.
log.emptyText: They appear once contacts sign in to the cabinet after publication.
log.noMatchText: Change the edition or the search.

panel.title: Offer and policy
panel.text: Editions, publication and the acceptance log. A published text does not change.
